I was looking at my Games via the SteamDB website and while it's crazy to have 3000 and 2000 hour games, I recently put 200 hours into Wardogs, which just came out, but then I saw Star Wars Outlaws, which I loved and played slowly, not fully completionist, but still a bunch.. and that took only 40 hours.

Judging time as an per hour number is very difficult for our brains to grasp, I guess.
